name: Is a pre-purchase roof inspection different from a standard home inspection?

mainEntity.name: Is a pre-purchase roof inspection different from a standard home inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a pre-purchase roof inspection is a specialized service that goes into greater depth than the roof section of a general home inspection. While a home inspector will visually assess the roof, a dedicated roof inspector will often get on the roof, closely examine components, and use specialized knowledge to identify subtle issues that a general inspector might miss. Our inspectors focus solely on the roof, providing a more granular and expert assessment compared to a broader home inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-purchase roof inspection is a specialized, in-depth assessment of the roof, more detailed than the general roof overview in a standard home inspection.
